source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted BatchCompactor error dispatch has a separate NS_MSG_ERROR_BLOCKED_COMPACTION branch that deliberately shows no alert. Its comment expects offline or pseudo operations to clear before a later attempt. This differs from malformed IMAP storage, local corruption, disk-full and busy-folder errors. Keep this blocked-operation outcome distinct when changing caller messages. The branch alone does not establish that compaction automatically retries or succeeds later. Existing notes cover remote redownload recovery and shutdown prompt suppression. This is a scoped static source contract and manual review recommendation. No blocked-operation injection, compaction, shutdown, runtime, build or live accessibility test ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Treat blocked compaction as a deferred operation without an error alert
